title: SkillAdam: Stable and Efficient Skill Evolution for Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.08944v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent skills provide a lightweight way to equip frozen language-model agents with domain knowledge and procedural guidance, yet obtaining high-quality skills remains costly and difficult to scale. Expert-written skills require substantial human effort. Recent skill self-evolution methods automate an iterative loop that uses execution feedback to revise skills, but their heuristic update strategies often yield unstable optimization and low iteration efficiency. We identify two challenges in realizing stable and efficient skill self-evolution. Direction Stability requires effective corrections to accumulate rather than be overwritten by iteration-local feedback. Update Adaptivity requires the scope of each revision to reflect the consistency of recent case-level improvements. translated_title: SkillAdam：面向智能体的稳定高效技能演化
translated_abstract: 智能体技能为冻结的语言模型智能体配备领域知识和程序性指导提供了一种轻量级方式，然而获取高质量技能仍然成本高昂且难以规模化。专家编写的技能需要大量人力投入。近期的技能自进化方法自动化了一个迭代循环，利用执行反馈来修订技能，但其启发式更新策略往往导致不稳定的优化和较低的迭代效率。我们识别出实现稳定且高效技能自进化的两个关键挑战：方向稳定性，要求有效的修正得以积累，而不是被迭代局部的反馈所覆盖；更新自适应性，要求每次修订的幅度应反映近期案例级改进的一致性。我们提出了 SkillAdam，一个受 Adam 优化器启发的框架，用于优化离散且不可微分的技能文档。作为 Adam 一阶矩的函数类比，……
tldr: 提出 SkillAdam 框架，借鉴 Adam 优化器的动量思想，通过保证方向稳定性与更新自适应性，实现智能体技能文档这一离散不可微对象的自进化优化，解决了现有启发式更新策略不稳定、迭代效率低的问题。
en_tdlr: SkillAdam is an Adam-inspired framework that enables stable and efficient self-evolution of discrete, non-differentiable agent skill documents by ensuring directional stability and update adaptivity in the revision process.
